{{Current events|year=2025|month=12|day=6|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Armed conflicts and attacks'''
*[[2025 Afghanistan–Pakistan conflict]]
**Five civilians are killed and eight more are injured in a [[shootout]] between [[Pakistan Army|Pakistani soldiers]] and [[Afghan Armed Forces|Afghan soldiers]] at [[Durand Line|the border]]. [https://apnews.com/article/afghanistan-pakistan-border-shootout-2d2766c8d15bf94369fb87b46185e1a8 (AP)]
*[[Terrorism in Mexico]]
**At least five people are killed and 12 others are injured in a suspected [[car bomb]]ing terrorist attack when a vehicle explodes outside of a police station in [[Coahuayana]], [[Michoacán]], [[Mexico]]. [https://bnonews.com/index.php/2025/12/mexico-opens-terrorism-investigation-after-car-bomb-explosion-kills-5/ (BNO News)]
*[[Colombian conflict]]
**At least thirteen people are injured in a [[Car bomb|motorcycle bombing]] at a [[café]] near a police station in [[Balboa, Cauca|Balboa]], [[Cauca Department]], [[Colombia]]. [https://www.bluradio.com/regiones/pacifico/nuevo-atentado-con-motocicleta-cargada-con-explosivos-sacude-a-balboa-en-el-sur-del-cauca-rg10 (Blu Radio <small>in Spanish</small>)] [https://www.infobae.com/colombia/2025/12/07/atentado-terrorista-en-cauca-este-es-el-momento-exacto-en-el-que-una-motocicleta-bomba-exploto-cerca-a-estacion-de-policia/ (Infobae <small>in Spanish</small>)]
*[[Israeli–Palestinian conflict]]
**Two [[Palestinians]] are killed and a soldier is injured when [[Israel Defense Forces]] soldiers open fire on a car speeding toward troops in [[Hebron]], [[West Bank]]. [https://www.timesofisrael.com/idf-two-palestinians-killed-after-speeding-car-toward-troops-in-hebron-soldier-lightly-hurt/ (''The Times of Israel'')]

'''Business and economy'''
*[[2025 IndiGo disruption]]
**The [[India]]n [[Ministry of Civil Aviation (India)|civil aviation ministry]] caps [[Domestic flight|domestic]] [[airfare]]s following widespread [[IndiGo]] cancellations caused by pilot shortages and operational failures, setting a maximum [[One-way travel|one-way]] price of [[Indian rupee|₹]]7,500 ([[United States dollar|US$]]83.38) for routes up to {{convert|500|km|mi|abbr=on}}. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/india-air-travel-chaos-eases-indigo-crisis-still-leaves-hundreds-stranded-2025-12-06/ (Reuters)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[2025 Arpora nightclub fire]]
**Twenty-five people are killed, including 21 workers and four tourists, and approximately 50 others are injured in an explosion and fire at a [[nightclub]] in [[Arpora]], [[Goa]], [[India]]. [https://www.ndtv.com/india-news/several-killed-in-goa-club-fire-gas-cylinder-explosion-suspected-9764853 (NDTV)] [https://www.dw.com/en/india-nightclub-fire-in-goa-kills-at-least-23/a-75048726 (DW)]
*At least 18 people are killed and two others are critically injured when a [[dinghy]] carrying migrants [[Shipwreck|sinks]] off [[Crete]], [[Greece]]. [https://greekreporter.com/2025/12/06/migrant-shipwreck-leaves-eighteen-dead-off-greeces-crete/ (Greek Reporter)]

'''International relations'''
*[[International sanctions against Afghanistan]]
**[[Australia]] imposes [[economic sanctions]] and [[travel ban]]s on four [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] [[Government of Afghanistan|government]] officials over their involvement in [[Human rights in Afghanistan|human rights]] violations, particularly the [[Taliban]]'s [[Treatment of women by the Taliban|treatment of women]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/asia-pacific/australia-hits-afghan-taliban-officials-with-sanctions-travel-bans-2025-12-06/ (Reuters)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2025 Saulsville shooting]]
**Twelve people are killed, including three children, and 13 others are injured in a [[mass shooting]] at an unlicensed [[Bar (establishment)|bar]] in [[Saulsville]], [[Gauteng]], [[South Africa]]. [https://apnews.com/article/south-africa-bar-mass-shooting-5e41acd3f2b46c9c1dce7a53e7d68845 (AP)]
*Four protesters from [[Just Stop Oil|Take Back Power]] are arrested after they threw [[custard]] on a display case containing the [[Crown Jewels of the United Kingdom|Crown Jewels]] in the [[Tower of London]] in [[England]]. [https://www.dw.com/en/uk-4-arrested-after-throwing-custard-at-crown-jewels/a-75047461 (DW)]

'''Sports'''
*[[MLS Cup 2025]]
**In [[soccer]], [[Inter Miami CF|Inter Miami]] defeats the [[Vancouver Whitecaps FC|Vancouver Whitecaps]] 3–1 to win its first [[MLS Cup]] title. [https://www.usatoday.com/story/sports/mls/2025/12/06/mls-cup-2025-messi-inter-miami-vancouver-whitecaps/87593022007/ (''USA Today'')]
<!-- All news items above this line -->}}
